notes: New look matching the Ascent web tools: cool white and navy with blue and teal, a bold animated Home with a 3D scene, and colour-coded suites. GST Tracker now lets you upload GST clients (GSTIN) or Income Tax clients (PAN) from a CSV or Excel file, fetch their details from the GST portal, and shows QRMP clients by quarter and composition clients on CMP-08, with no blank months.
